question: What is the relative difference in percentage points of saving note redemption rate out of the average amount outstanding for the 1980 and 1981 calendar years, rounded to the nearest hundredth places?
raw_response:
The question specifies "average amount outstanding," which indicates using the average of beginning and ending outstanding amounts (the standard approach). 

- 1980 redemption rate = 71 / ((352+300)/2) = 71/326 = 21.78%
- 1981 redemption rate = 51 / ((300+269)/2) = 51/284.5 = 17.93%

Relative difference in percentage points = 21.78 - 17.93 = 3.85 pp

Both values contain decimal points, so per MODE A formatting, bare comma — but this is a single value answer (3.85).

<FINAL_ANSWER>3.85</FINAL_ANSWER>
